_: Doll 2's wearable things (DOLL2.md). make-items.mjs writes every prompt from this file; lib/town/wear.ts names them in the game. Ids are letters only. An outfit is three sheets (front, back, poses: in-place edits of d2-mannequin-*) and their skin keys; a head thing is one sheet a view it shows in. `key`: what a key copy calls the thing, where "the hat" or the slot's word is not enough (Codex's read, 2026-10-17). `solid`: a thing whole inside its outline (hats are, unless false): what its outline closes in is cut with it.
